identification: Glenfiddich Special Old Reserve Pure Malt Scotch Whisky, 750ml, green triangular bottle with older stag label ('Pure Malt', Distilled and Bottled in Scotland), likely 1980s to early 1990s bottling. Seal and cap look intact with good fill in the photo. Not a rare release: this was the standard Glenfiddich of its day.

chrome_hint: eBay.com.au sold listings: 'Glenfiddich Special Old Reserve Pure Malt 750ml' and 'Glenfiddich Pure Malt 750ml 1980s' (sold, last 90 days, Australia). Terapeak research on the same. Whisky Auctioneer, Just Whisky, whisky.auction, Scotch Whisky Auctions, Grays Online and Lawsons for 'Glenfiddich Special Old Reserve' and 'Glenfiddich Pure Malt' results. Check bottle size (750ml vs 700ml vs 1L) and fill level in each comp. Also WhiskyBase for the bottling year.
viewing_check: Check fill level (shoulder or neck), seal and cap condition, label condition and any batch or year code on the back label or bottle base, plus the ABV and volume print (750ml, 40% or 43%) to date the bottling.
